profile.aboutHeadline: B.Sc. (Hons.) CS Student & Full Stack Developer.
profile.aboutSubheadline: I am a B.Sc. Computer Science (Honours) student (2024–2028) at Rajagiri College of Social Sciences, Full Stack Developer, UI/UX Designer, and Graphic Designer.
profile.aboutBio: I began my industry journey at ERA, a college startup, working as a UI/UX Designer crafting user interfaces and product designs. I then moved to Developer Lab—which was originally a sub-company under ERA and is now a standalone company—expanding my scope into Graphic Designing and Full Stack Web Development. I thrive at the intersection of robust backend logic and elegant visual experiences.

journey.title: Developer Lab — Full Stack & Graphic Design
journey.description: Joined Developer Lab—initially established as a specialized sub-company under ERA and now operating as a standalone company. Spearheaded Full Stack Development and Graphic Designing, building end-to-end web apps, clean APIs, and modern visual branding.

journey.title: ERA — UI/UX Designer & Module Development
journey.description: Worked at ERA, an innovative college startup. Led UI/UX design workflows, created intuitive interface prototypes, user journeys, and contributed key feature modules for flagship platforms like Mentur.

journey.title: Full Stack Engineering & AI Integration
journey.description: Engineered comprehensive web applications with Laravel, PHP, Python, FastAPI, and MySQL. Integrated intelligent features including RAG pipelines with ChromaDB and Ollama for automated assistance.

journey.title: B.Sc. (Hons.) Computer Science Foundation
journey.description: Pursuing 4-year Honours Degree (2024–2028) at Rajagiri College of Social Sciences. Deepening theoretical fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, databases, and software engineering.
